turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're taking our electric car on holiday for the first time. I'm worried we'll run out of charge somewhere.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Totally normal worry. How far is the trip, and what's your car's real range in practice?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Changing the subject, the grout in my shower has gone all grey and grim.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can deep clean it, paint over it with a grout pen, or scrape it out and regrout. How much effort do you want to put in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My mate's just sat down next to me. Couple of minutes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Have you seen my phone charger?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I think it's in the bedroom.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sam, does this essay make sense? I've read it so many times the words look fake.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Hand it over. How long is it supposed to be?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Two thousand words. I'm at two thousand four hundred.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: This whole paragraph about the history of the factory, do you need it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Maybe not. I just found it interesting.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then cut it. Your argument starts on page two, it should start on page one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh. You're right, but it hurts.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done talking to them. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. Your shower grout. Cleaning, a pen, or redoing it?
